title: feat(app-shell): Connect an Agent adds WorkBuddy, Doubao Work and QwenWork, merges the Claude cards
body:
Fixes #30029

## What changes

The **Connect an Agent** page (the `mcp:connect-agent` widget in `@object-ui/app-shell`, reached from Account → Developer and from Setup) now lists, in one grid:

- **Claude**: one full-width card with two halves, the claude.ai / Claude Desktop connector and the Claude Code CLI with its plugin. These were two cards before.
- **Codex**: the Codex app's MCP form (Settings → MCP servers → Add server). It shows the name, transport and URL to enter, then where to sign in and how to check the connection. It replaces the Codex CLI `config.toml` snippet.
- **Cursor**: unchanged.
- **WorkBuddy** (new): the `mcpServers` entry with WorkBuddy's `streamableHttp` spelling, plus the Trust step.
- **Doubao Work** (new): the name / transport / URL its custom-connector form asks for.
- **QwenWork** (new): the `mcpServers` JSON with QwenWork's `streamable-http` spelling.
- **API keys**: unchanged, except that a minted key is now also revealed as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` beside `x-api-key`. The new cards name that header as their fallback.

Also in this PR:

- The VS Code / Copilot card is dropped, with `connectAgent.vscode.body`.
- The Doubao Work and QwenWork titles are strings, so zh shows 豆包工作 and 千问办公.
- Form-style clients render their values as copyable rows (a new `FieldRows` helper).
- Long one-line snippets now wrap instead of clipping.
- Every new or changed string is in all ten built-in packs.
- `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` gains a Codex / WorkBuddy / Doubao Work / QwenWork section.
- `packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts` updates only its doc comment.

Nothing on the server changes. The MCP endpoint, OAuth and API-key handling stay as they are; `Authorization: Bearer <key>` was already accepted.

## Why

#30029. People here use WorkBuddy, Doubao Work, QwenWork and the Codex app as their agents, and the page told them nothing about where each takes a custom MCP server or how each spells the transport. The maintainer also chose the order (international clients first, Chinese ones after, Codex ahead of Cursor), the single-list layout, the merged Claude card and the dropped VS Code card.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/` (from `ui/`): green. The widget pin file gains a top-level `describe` for card order, the transport spelling each client gets, the form rows and the Bearer reveal.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (both tsconfigs): clean. `ui/scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`: every key resolves.
- Two existing pins were re-measured, not loosened:
  - `de-quote-pairing-3876`'s census moves 103 → 102, because the retired `connectAgent.vscode.body` quoted „MCP: Add Server“.
  - `untranslated-identity-4376` gains two proper-noun entries, `connectAgent.doubao.title` and `connectAgent.qwenwork.title`.
- Dogfooded on a real boot: showcase backend with `--fresh --seed-admin` on its own port, the Console dev server on current `ui/` source pointed at it, signed in as the seeded admin. The zh page renders the cards above, with the deployment's real MCP URL in every snippet.
- After merging `origin/main`: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` (119/119 tasks), then `pnpm lint` (clean), then a full `pnpm test`. That test run had printed no failure after more than two hours but had not finished when this PR was opened: the UI suite runs unsharded in one process locally. CI's sharded required jobs are the record for it.
- Not verified: the client-side menu paths and transport spellings against a live install of each client. They come from vendor docs and third-party guides, and the card says where to look if a version differs.

- [ ] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. The branch is the session's assigned `claude/zen-davinci-tfxqme`, not `claude/issue-30029-*`, and `origin/main` is merged in. One issue, one PR.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. All of it except the full local `pnpm test`, which had not finished (see Verification).
